item.description: I want to thank Uzbekistan's Highly Respected President, Shavkat Mirziyoyev, for the beautiful Uzbek Gazebos (or “Aywans”) gifted to me in honor of our Country’s 250 years of Independence. It was my Honor to do a flyover in Marine One during last week’s Gazebo Ceremony featuring Uzbek Ambassador Furqat Sidikov and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum — and the Gazebos look STUNNING! Uzbek master craftsmen left their families in Uzbekistan for several months, and skillfully built these Gazebos out of 200-year-old mountain walnut trees, in tough weather conditions. They had real talent! Rather than keep this gift as “private,” I wanted to donate these beautiful Gazebos to the Public, right next to the Tidal Basin, with views of the Jefferson Memorial and Washington Monument, in our now Safe and Beautiful Capital. A year from now, when the National Garden of Heroes opens, these Gazebos will be one of the “hottest” places in town for marriage proposals, diplomatic receptions, photoshoots during the Cherry Blossom Festival, and every day visits to the Tidal Basin. I also want to thank the Uzbek Embassy in Washington and the National Park Service, who worked closely alongside the Great Uzbek Craftsmen. We are making D.C. More Beautiful than Ever Before! President DONALD J. TRUMP [Image Attached]
